ownerQuestions.question: Which OS versions, architectures, Linux display/compositor environments, assistive technologies, IMEs and touch/input devices define the first release support matrix?
ownerQuestions.recommendation: Record an explicit owner-approved support matrix; keep unavailable combinations OPEN with reasons.
ownerQuestions.tradeoff: Makes release support explicit without guessing exclusions or treating absent hardware as a successful test.
ownerQuestions.route: Research coordinator consolidates with release/root; do not ask the owner again from this leaf.

ownerQuestions.question: Which optional-feature candidates are accepted for the first release, and which are visibly deferred in their owning issues?
ownerQuestions.recommendation: Keep local core usable without services; require disabled and authorized-enabled/failure evidence for accepted optional features.
ownerQuestions.tradeoff: Deferred features remain visible rather than receiving an unverified parity claim.
ownerQuestions.route: Research coordinator consolidates owning-issue decisions at root.
